EC1: Evidence of decompensated liver disease  (Childs B-C) [OR], hepato-cellular carcinoma [OR], pre-existing severe depression [OR] or other psychiatric disease [OR], significant cardiac disease [OR], significant renal disease [OR], seizure disorders [OR] or severe [OR] retinopathy.
EC2: received telbivudine as the antiviral therapy [OR] or have received more than one [OR] NA in the past.
EC3: received interferon [OR] or peginterferon treatment in the past.
EC4: received antiviral therapy  for any systemic anti-viral [OR], anti-neoplastic [OR] or immuno-modulatory treatment (including supraphysiologic doses of steroids [OR] and radiation) within the past 6 months.
EC5: Positive test at screening for anti-HIV [OR] , anti-HCV.
EC6: Patients who are expected to need systemic antiviral therapy other than that provided by the study at any time during their participation in the study are also excluded. [NOT] Exception: patients who have had a limited (<=7 days) course of acyclovir [AND] for herpetic lesions more than 1 month prior to the first administration of test drug are not excluded.
EC7: Serum total bilirubin > 3 times the upper limit of normal at screening.
EC8: History or other evidence of bleeding  from esophageal varices [OR] or other conditions consistent with decompensated liver disease.
EC9: History or other evidence of a medical condition associated [AND] with chronic liver disease [NOT] other than HBV (e.g., hemochromatosis [OR], autoimmune hepatitis [OR], metabolic liver diseases including Wilson's [OR] and alpha1-antitrypsin deficiency [OR], alcoholic liver disease [OR], toxin exposures [OR], thalassemia).
EC10: Women with ongoing pregnancy [OR] or who are breast feeding.
EC11: Neutrophil count  <1500 cells/mm3 [OR] or platelet count <90,000 cells/mm3 at screening.
EC12: Hemoglobin < 11.5 g/dL for females [OR] and < 12.5 g/dL for men at screening.
EC13: Serum creatinine level >120 umol/ml for men and >105 umol/ml for women at screening.
EC14: History of severe psychiatric disease, especially depression. Severe psychiatric disease is defined as major depression [OR] or psychosis [OR], a period of treatment [OR] with an antidepressant medication [OR] or major tranquilizer at therapeutic doses for depression or psychosis  for at least 3 months [OR], a suicidal attempt [OR], hospitalization [OR] for psychiatric disease [OR], or a period of disability [AND] due to a psychiatric disease.
EC15: History of immunologically mediated disease (e.g., inflammatory bowel disease [OR], idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura [OR], lupus erythematosus [OR], autoimmune hemolytic anemia [OR], scleroderma [OR], severe psoriasis [OR], rheumatoid arthritis).
EC16: History or other evidence of chronic pulmonary disease [AND] associated with functional limitation. Severe cardiac disease (e.g., NYHA [OR] Functional Class III or IV, myocardial infarction [OR] within 6 months [OR], ventricular tachyarrhythmias requiring ongoing treatment, unstable angina [OR] or other significant cardiovascular diseases).
EC17: History of a severe seizure disorder [OR] or current anticonvulsant use.
EC18: Evidence of an active [OR] or suspected cancer [OR] or a history of malignancy [AND] where the risk of recurrence is >=20% within 2 years. Patients with a lesion suspicious [AND] of hepatic malignancy on a screening imaging study [AND] will only be eligible if the likelihood of carcinoma is <=10% following an appropriate evaluation.
EC19: History of having received any systemic anti-neoplastic  (including radiation) [OR] or immunomodulatory treatment (including systemic corticosteroids) [OR] <=6 months prior to the first dose of study drug [OR] or the expectation that such treatment will be needed at any time during the study.
EC21: Thyroid disease [AND] with thyroid function poorly controlled on prescribed medications. Patients with abnormal thyroid stimulating hormone [OR] or T4 concentrations [OR], with elevation of antibodies to thyroid peroxidase [OR] and any clinical manifestations of thyroid disease are excluded.
EC22: History or other evidence of severe retinopathy  (e.g. CMV retinitis [OR], macula degeneration) [OR] or clinically relevant  ophthalmological disorder due to diabetes mellitus [OR] or hypertension
EC23: Inability or unwillingness to provide informed consent or abide by the requirements of the study.
EC24: History or other evidence of severe illness or any other conditions which would make the patient, in the opinion of the investigator, unsuitable for the study.
EC25: Patients with a value of alpha-fetoprotein >100 ng/mL are excluded, [NOT] unless stability (less than 10% increase) has been documented over at least the previous 3 months.
EC26: Evidence of drug [OR] and/or alcohol abuse [AND] (20g/day for women [OR] & 30g/day for men).
EC27: Patients included in another trial or having been given investigational drugs within 12 weeks prior to screening
EC28: Any known history of [AND] hypersensitivity  to interferon.
